name: 34114 · Naples, FL
findings: ZIP 34114 (Naples) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34114 (Naples) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34114 (Naples) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
